title: Facet force at L1-L2 - Schendel et al. 1993 (J Biomech 26:427) (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: facet force from extra-articular strain gauges (single values as printed)

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Schendel et al. 1993 (J Biomech 26:427)); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Schendel et al. 1993 (J Biomech 26:427), as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Moments with small axial preloads (150-190 N); strain gauges on bone surface.
how_to_simulate: Apply axial preload 150-190 N plus the moment (10 Nm AR/extension/flexion, 3 Nm LB)
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (the user's own review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Schendel et al. 1993 (J Biomech 26:427).

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
